Access: USD is available without an API key; every other currency returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: event_impact_replay_task

tools.name: quant_scenario_lab_task
tools.description: Run an expanded quant-style policy scenario for an FX pair with deterministic projection, stress percentiles, and horizon assumptions. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: requires an FXMacroData API key; an anonymous call returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.name: macro_regime_classifier_task

tools.name: portfolio_risk_engine_task
tools.description: Analyze a multi-position FX book for concentration, stress exposure, and event-driven catalyst risk. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: requires an FXMacroData API key; an anonymous call returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

tools.description: Build a trader-oriented FX pair setup using spot context, macro differentials, upcoming catalyst risk, and optional COT positioning. Returns analysis in the tool response. Access: requires an FXMacroData API key; an anonymous call returns subscription_required with a subscribe link.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: organisation_search, organisation_profile · Private data: data_catalogue, risk_sentiment, macro_news, release_calendar, release_calendar_visual_artifact, event_predictions, latest_announcements, press_releases, rate_curve, rate_differentials, forex, seasonality, indicator_query, plot_visual_artifact, macro_briefing_task, indicator_intel_task, pair_intel_task, policy_scenario_modeler_task, macro_war_room_task, event_impact_replay_task, quant_scenario_lab_task, macro_regime_classifier_task, release_risk_score_task, portfolio_risk_engine_task, fx_trade_setup_task, fx_backtest_task, research_run, research_paper, macro_research_pack_task, market_sessions, cot_data, commodities, organisation_search, organisation_profile, official_datasets · Public sink: rate_curve, research_run · Destructive: policy_scenario_modeler_task, quant_scenario_lab_task, fx_backtest_task, research_run.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: organisation_search, organisation_profile · Private data: data_catalogue, risk_sentiment, macro_news, release_calendar, release_calendar_visual_artifact, event_predictions, latest_announcements, press_releases, rate_curve, rate_differentials, forex, seasonality, indicator_query, plot_visual_artifact, macro_briefing_task, indicator_intel_task, pair_intel_task, policy_scenario_modeler_task, macro_war_room_task, event_impact_replay_task, quant_scenario_lab_task, macro_regime_classifier_task, release_risk_score_task, portfolio_risk_engine_task, fx_trade_setup_task, fx_backtest_task, research_run, research_paper, macro_research_pack_task, market_sessions, cot_data, commodities, organisation_search, organisation_profile, official_datasets · Public sink: rate_curve, research_run · Destructive: policy_scenario_modeler_task, quant_scenario_lab_task, fx_backtest_task, research_run

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
